_comment_file: Copy to splunk_config.json and edit. Keys starting with _comment are ignored. Do NOT put your token or password here - type them in the app, or set the SPLUNK_TOKEN environment variable.
_comment_host: Splunk server name. Splunk Cloud: <stack>.splunkcloud.com (port 8089 may need to be allowed through the IP allowlist).
_comment_port: Splunk MANAGEMENT port (REST API). Default 8089. Not 8000 (web) or 8088 (HEC).
_comment_scheme: https in normal use. http only for a local test server.
_comment_verify_ssl: Keep true. If you get a certificate error, set ca_bundle instead of turning this off.
_comment_ca_bundle: Optional path to your company CA bundle (.pem), e.g. C:\certs\company-ca.pem. Used instead of verify_ssl when set.
_comment_default_indexes: Indexes pre-selected in the app, e.g. ["k8s"]. Empty = search every index your role can access.
_comment_fields: Field names that hold the cluster, namespace and pod in YOUR Splunk events. Splunk Connect for Kubernetes: cluster_name / namespace / pod. OpenTelemetry collector: k8s.cluster.name / k8s.namespace.name / k8s.pod.name. Check one event in Splunk to see which you have.
_comment_use_tstats: true = fast listing of clusters/namespaces/pods when those fields are indexed fields. The app automatically falls back to a normal search if tstats finds nothing.
_comment_discovery_lookback_hours: Default look-back when listing clusters and namespaces. Can be changed in the app.
_comment_max_events: Default maximum number of log events to fetch in one go.
_comment_hard_max_events: Upper limit the app will allow for 'maximum events', to protect Splunk and your browser.
_comment_search_timeout_seconds: Give up waiting for a Splunk search after this many seconds.
_comment_parallel_pages: How many result pages (50,000 events each) are downloaded from Splunk at the same time. 4 is a good default; use 1 if your Splunk admin asks you to go easy on the REST API.
